title: pack

messages.description: type according to argument. causes output

arguments.description: types of inlets: float/symbol/pointer (f/s/p). a number sets a numeric inlet and initializes the value. f is initialized to 0

body: [pack] combines several atoms into one list. The left inlet is hot: it outputs the list, while the other inlets only store their values. The arguments set the number of elements and their types: f for float, s for symbol, p for pointer, or a number as an initial float.
